originalStrengths: Clear frontal brow, long nose, inset eyes and mouth read as a carved face.
Substantial blue footing and tall pale head separate in silhouette.
originalWeaknesses: Very bright, nearly featureless upper stone planes lose material and weathering; broad back is blank.
Lime cuboids read as attached toy blocks rather than organic reef growth.
Face components look like stacked clean bars, with little worn construction or fracture logic.
Deep blue footing has large dark featureless patches and minimal stone breakup.
targetUsefulOutcomes: Pale warm stone has readable midtones, rounded worn edge planes, restrained chips and meaningful fractures.
Heavy brow, eye recesses, nose and lips feel built into a coherent carved head; crown has weathered mass.
Green growth wraps contacts, crown and select cracks, with soft lobes and a few thick plant forms; blue footing gains broad readable facets and a few grounded pale rubble accents.
Warm highlights and cooler shaded planes make stone, growth and blue rock distinct.
targetNotMandatory: Exact target part counts, moss/crown count, crack paths, extra stacked upper slabs and every tiny pebble.
Painted microtexture, asymmetrical directional yellow light, target halo/specks or enlargement.
Invented reference views on the rear; coherent native back/side finish is required without duplicating the face.

observed: Four-direction row retains recognizable tall pale ruin silhouettes on turquoise tiles.
At phone Fit, cuboid green crown and blank white slabs dominate; eye/nose details recede. Broad material, wear and growth decisions must survive this size.
